answer: On the prism, each violet is born only after two unrelated attested sponsors endorse it; a sponsor can sell one endorsement, posting a stake of ripple that burns if that violet is ruled fake. Cheapest asks go first, so each further ask is higher; fielding k clones takes 2k distinct endorsements, so the bill is the sum of the 2k lowest asks, paid in ripple. Asks are indivisible, and parallel clones drain the same list; call this sponsor-gated bonding. A duplicate violet under the same sponsor pair is killed. It breaks if a sponsor delegates its endorsement right to one proxy that sells many.
